message.zapeg_runtime.quest.ashen_scratc: The cold ash keeps the scratch.
message.zapeg_runtime.quest.backward_tra: The rain remembers the steps you denied.
message.zapeg_runtime.quest.ninth_bell.c: The ninth toll answers from somewhere below.
message.zapeg_runtime.quest.drowned_road: The drowned road has learned your weight.
message.zapeg_runtime.quest.underdoor.co: Something passed beneath the little door with you.
message.zapeg_runtime.quest.ninth_witnes: Eight empty faces watched you become the ninth.
message.zapeg_runtime.quest.name_refusal: The unused name curls into blue smoke.
The line tightens around a name you cannot see.
message.zapeg_runtime.quest.seal_01.comp: The first seal takes the ember.
message.zapeg_runtime.quest.seal_02.comp: The second seal takes the drowned light.
message.zapeg_runtime.quest.seal_03.comp: The third seal takes the echo.
tooltip.zapeg_runtime.heraldor_journal.o: Use to read the authorized pages
message.zapeg_runtime.journal.granted: A book you do not remember owning settles into your inventory.
message.zapeg_runtime.journal.restored: The lost journal goes cold. A newly bound copy answers you.
message.zapeg_runtime.journal.inventory_: The journal cannot arrive. Free one main-inventory slot.
message.zapeg_runtime.journal.missing: The bound journal is missing. Ask an operator to restore it by UUID.
message.zapeg_runtime.journal.data_unava: The journal binding ledger is unavailable; no copy was issued.
message.zapeg_runtime.journal.inert: This copy no longer knows you.
message.zapeg_runtime.journal.action.no_: The ink refuses a reader without the active journal.
message.zapeg_runtime.journal.action.una: The page closes before the mark can settle.
message.zapeg_runtime.journal.action.not: There is nothing more to uncover on this page yet.
message.zapeg_runtime.journal.action.rev: Hidden ink rises, then fixes itself into the record.
screen.zapeg_runtime.heraldor_journal.re: This sign has already entered the record. Its old instruction has faded.
screen.zapeg_runtime.heraldor_journal.ac: Hold the page to the light
Examine the mark recorded on this page
The ink is deciding whether to remember…
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.first_scr: The first mark was not carved into wood. It was carved into the moment after flame, where warmth had left but ash still remembered a hand.
After sunset, crouch and use a Brush on an extinguished Campfire.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.voice_wit: It spoke without breath and chose no direction. Every wall returned a different ending to the same unfinished sentence.
When the airless voice finds you, remain through its final silence.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.tracks_ag: Rain erased every trail except the one that arrived heel-first. Those prints did not follow me. They waited for me to fit them.
While rain falls, move continuously backward at least 6 blocks over 40 ticks on Mud, Coarse Dirt, or Dirt Path.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.empty_bed: The blanket sank beneath a weight with no body. At dawn the hollow was cold, and the room had learned my breathing.
Endure the visitation until the room releases you.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.ink_benea: A second account presses upward through these lines. It was written first, crossed out second, and has been waiting behind my words ever since.
The overwritten sentence is still here. Hold this page to the light.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.name_refu: A name grants a shape permission to remain. Leave the label empty, and let the blue fire deny what waits to be called.
Crouch and use an unrenamed Name Tag from your main hand on a lit Soul Campfire.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.far_figur: Distance did not make it smaller. The horizon bent around it as if the world were trying not to stand in front.
Watch the far edge when the world asks you to look away.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.servant_o: The Stalker lives in the space between seeing and reaching. Each step toward it lengthens the road behind you.
Defeat the Stalker that carries Heraldor's distance.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.ninth_bel: Eight strokes belong to the tower. The ninth belongs to whatever counts from beneath it.
Ring the same loaded Bell 9 times within 30 seconds.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.threshold: The door remained shut. The threshold opened anyway, and something crossed through the meaning of entrance.
Survive the breach and witness its last impossible frame.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.drowned_r: Below the water, gravel remembered cartwheels. The road continued where lungs were never meant to follow.
Keep your eyes submerged and walk at least 8 blocks over 60 ticks on continuous Gravel.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.saltless_: A tide rose without sea or salt. It left every surface dry and every shadow dripping.
Witness the tide omen when low water comes where no ocean should be.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.herald_at: The Herald announced no king. Its mouth carried an emptiness trained to sound like command.
Defeat the Herald before its omen finishes sounding.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.borrowed_: Tonight it used a voice I trusted. The words were wrong, but the pauses knew exactly where grief would listen.
Hear the borrowed voice to its end; resemblance is its trap.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.three_kno: One knock asks. Two warn. Three mean the visitor has stopped waiting for an answer.
Do not open anything. Let the three-knock sequence complete.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.house_tha: The house leans close after dark, listening through its wooden teeth. A still body against the door can hear the foundation answer.
At night, crouch motionless against a closed wooden Door for 60 ticks.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.binder_kn: A loose end is an invitation. Fasten the lead where a taut string already listens, and the knot will name its keeper.
Crouch and use a Lead from your main hand on a Tripwire Hook attached to string.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.servant_o: The Binder knots names to bodies and pulls until neither remembers which one was borrowed.
Defeat the Binder and keep hold of the name it tries to take.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.ledger_of: The ledger records what was removed, never what remained. Its blank lines are entries whose owners have been erased.
The gaps are numbered. Count the missing lines, not the written ones.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.door_belo: Every threshold casts a lower threshold. Beneath the stone, it opens only for a traveler too low to stand.
Below Y=0 and out of water, crawl at least 3 blocks beneath a closed Trapdoor.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.first_sea: The first seal asks for heat disciplined into powder and a red flame made small enough to command.
Crouch and offer 3 Blaze Powder from your main hand to Chiseled Deepslate topped by a lit red Candle.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.second_se: The second seal remembers a sea pressed into crystal. Blue light must teach that memory to stay beneath stone.
Crouch and offer 3 Prismarine Crystals from your main hand to Chiseled Deepslate topped by a lit blue Candle.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.third_sea: The last seal wants an echo with no speaker. Black flame is the only witness it will accept.
Crouch and offer 1 Echo Shard from your main hand to Chiseled Deepslate topped by a lit black Candle.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.face_in_s: Clouds became eyelids around a face too large for weather. It did not descend; the world rose toward it.
Witness the colossus until the sky becomes empty again.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.broken_pr: The procession marched in missing pieces: footfall, shadow, bell, then the space where a mourner should have been.
Remain beside the broken procession through its final footfall.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.ninth_wit: Eight silent bodies face outward. The ninth witness must choose to look inward through a narrow glass.
At night, use a Spyglass for 40 ticks within 5 blocks of exactly 8 Armor Stands.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.hull_bene: A ship lies below the mountain with its keel turned toward the moon. Something vast still circles its dry wreck.
Follow the shipwreck vision until the buried hull reveals its course.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.first_sha: Its first shape was an argument made from armor and tide. Breaking it only taught the thing a larger answer.
Break the Ninth Form's first phase and survive what emerges.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.last_shap: The final shape carries every rejected name at once. There is no face beneath them—only the will to be remembered.
Defeat the Ninth Form. Its size is not its whole body.
journal.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.after_nin: The ninth shape fell, and morning returned to the correct side of every window. One page remains warm. I will not write a tenth.
The record is complete. If another page appears, do not let it learn your hand.
advancements.zapeg_runtime.heraldor.bani: The Ninth Form is banished, but one page remains warm.
